bias.zh: 回调 · 失守 $195，下看 9 月低点

read.en: Zscaler fell 2.1% on Nov 10 to $194.92, trading $188.91–201.56. It is above the 100-day ($182.7) and 200-day ($166.8) and below the 5-day ($204.0), 10-day ($221.0) and 30-day ($221.9); only the 30 and 100-day are rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($248.79), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月10日下跌 2.1%，收于 $194.92，盘中区间 $188.91–201.56。股价位于 100 日（$182.7）和 200 日（$166.8）均线上方，5 日（$204.0）、10 日（$221.0）和 30 日（$221.9）均线下方；仅 30、100 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$248.79），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close lost the $195.1–195.8 support (Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows, Nov 9 low), now resistance; the $188.91 low stopped above the $187.5–187.7 September lows. Resistance is $195.1–195.8, then $201.6–204 (Nov 9–10 highs, Nov 5 low, 5-day) and $210.5–214.5. Support is $187.5–188.9 (September lows, Nov 10 low), then $182.7 (100-day) and $166.8 (200-day). A close above $195.8 would target $202–204; below $187.5, $182.7.
